story: United Nations climate talks in Antalya, Turkey, collapsed without a deal after the European Union and other countries rejected a draft that made no mention of fossil fuels.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said naval drones sank a Russian warship and struck a cargo ship at a port in Benghazi, Libya.
Nvidia’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive after President Donald Trump urged his return, less than two weeks after he resigned over personal scandals.
Democrat Chuck Hubbard defeated longtime Republican Representative Virginia Foxx in North Carolina after a recount, giving Democrats their largest House majority in decades.
India announced a $1.62 billion aid package to help Nepal rebuild after deadly August floods during Nepali Prime Minister Balendra Shah’s visit to New Delhi.
